question: Find the city and name of the magnet school with the highest number of students scoring 1500 or more on the SAT that is located in a county containing at least one locally funded charter school. Also return the school's phone number and opening date.

prediction.sql:
WITH charter_counties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_045 AS county
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
      AND f.XCL_015 = 'Locally funded'
),
sat_counts AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_041 AS cds,
           sat.XCL_040 AS high_sat_students
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
    WHERE s.XCL_077 = 1
)
SELECT s.XCL_050 AS city,
       s.XCL_047 AS name,
       s.XCL_058 AS phone,
       s.XCL_061 AS opening_date
FROM sat_counts sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.XCL_041
WHERE s.XCL_045 IN (SELECT county FROM charter_counties)
ORDER BY sc.high_sat_students DESC
LIMIT 1;

    SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_045 AS county
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001

      AND f.XCL_015 = 'Locally funded'
),
sat_counts AS (

)

WHERE s.XCL_045 IN (SELECT county FROM charter_counties)
ORDER BY sc.high_sat_students DESC
LIMIT 1;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH charter_counties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_045 AS county
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_046 = 'Charter' AND f.XCL_015 = 'Locally funded'
),
sat_counts AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_041 AS cds,
           SUM(sat.XCL_035) AS high_sat_students
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
    WHERE s.XCL_046 = 'Magnet'
      AND sat.XCL_036 >= 1500
    GROUP BY s.XCL_041
)
SELECT s.XCL_055 AS city,
       s.XCL_047 AS name,
       s.XCL_043 AS phone,
       s.XCL_062 AS opening_date
FROM sat_counts sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.XCL_041
WHERE s.XCL_045 IN (SELECT county FROM charter_counties)
ORDER BY sc.high_sat_students DESC
LIMIT 1;
